15.t: Working with data: breathing during exercise
q: State the breathing rate at rest.
At what time did the running start and stop?
Started at about 2 min, stopped at about 7 min.
Explain why breathing gets faster during running.
Muscles respire faster, needing more oxygen and making more carbon dioxide; faster breathing brings in O₂ and removes CO₂.
Breathing took 8 minutes to return to normal. Explain why it stayed high after stopping.
The body must repay the oxygen debt: extra oxygen is needed to remove lactic acid made when muscles ran short of oxygen.
